mapper.select: SELECT l.id AS factId,l.business_no AS businessNo,l.payment_no AS paymentNo,p.order_no AS orderNo,l.entry_type AS kind,l.amount_cents AS amountCents,l.currency,DATE_FORMAT(l.occurred_at,'%Y-%m-%dT%H:%i:%s.%fZ') AS occurredAt FROM payment_ledger l JOIN payment_order p ON p.payment_no=l.payment_no WHERE l.id > #{after} ORDER BY l.id LIMIT #{size}
